MediaOverride.title: MediaOverride
MediaOverride.description: Cloud-synced companion metadata for a GalleryHub media item (favorites, custom tags, renamed title, Private Vault hidden flag, and extracted OCR text).

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this metadata record.

mediaId.description: Corresponding media item ID from the Render/MongoDB backend.

favorite.description: Whether the user favorited this media item.

customTags.description: User-defined #tags attached to this media item (max 30).

renamedTitle.description: Optional user-edited display title for this media item.

hiddenInVault.description: Whether this item is hidden inside the Biometric Private Vault.

ocrText.description: Optional on-device ML Kit OCR extracted text for cross-device search.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every update.

StudioState.title: StudioState
StudioState.description: Cloud-synced studio preferences, Private Vault PIN hash, and permanently dismissed activity IDs.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this studio state document.

vaultPinHash.description: Optional salted SHA-256 hash of the user's 4-digit Private Vault PIN.

vaultBiometricEnabled.description: Whether biometric unlock is enabled for Private Vault.

clearedActivityIds.description: Activity item IDs cleared by the user so they stay hidden after server refreshes (max 200).

accentHex.description: Hex color of the chosen Studio accent preset.

exifScrubDefaultOn.description: Default toggle for EXIF metadata scrubbing on external share.

wifiOnlyUploads.description: Whether background uploads wait for Wi-Fi connectivity.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every update.

/users/{userId}/mediaOverrides/{mediaId}.description: Per-user cloud-synced overrides (favorites, tags, renames, hidden vault status, OCR text) keyed by media ID.

/users/{userId}/studioState/{docId}.description: Per-user cloud-synced studio settings, Private Vault salted PIN hash, and cleared activity IDs.
